title: Advantage of Entangled Learning Rules in Quantum Measurement Class Learning
summary: Learning with data in the form of quantum states is of current interest and has led to a variety of problems that boil down to interaction with the available data via quantum measurement and classical post-processing of observed classical outcomes. In quantum measurement PAC learning, one is given a sequence of unknown, prepared quantum states and classical labels, along with a hypothesis class of candidate measurements.
